course_subtitle: Welcome to the world of artificial intelligence and machine learning! Here you will create smart systems that recognize faces, simulate ChatGPT, and play rock-paper-scissors with you programmatically. Unlock stations and discover the secrets of the future!

stations.title: Station 1: K-Nearest Neighbor (K-NN) algorithm
stations.desc: Learn how AI classifies new objects based on their nearest neighbors in geometric distance.
stations.story: Welcome, future scientist, to the Artificial Intelligence Laboratory! In order to make the computer recognize objects, we use a simple and intelligent algorithm called (K-NN). It ranks any unknown element according to the majority of its nearest neighbors!
stations.simple: Imagine that you are in a new school and you do not know where to sit! If you find 3 students who love programming sitting at one desk, and one student who loves drawing at another desk, naturally you will sit with the majority of your neighbors who are into programming!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("Object was successfully classified using K-NN") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the magic statement Item was classified successfully using K-NN to simulate the working of the nearest neighbor algorithm.
stations.starter_code:
# Simulate the K-NN algorithm for data classification:
neighbors = 3

pills.label: Run K-NN classification
pills.code: print("The item was successfully classified using K-NN")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The item was successfully classified using K-NN

stations.title: Station 2: Detect faces with the camera (OpenCV)
stations.desc: Use the Computer Vision (OpenCV) library and the Haar Cascade algorithm to identify and draw boxes around heroes' faces!
stations.story: The computer can see through the digital camera! We use the famous Python library (OpenCV) and pass it a fast algorithm that searches for light differences in the face (Haar Cascade) to draw a box around it immediately.
stations.simple: Like Snapchat and Instagram filters! As soon as you open the camera, the artificial intelligence recognizes the location of your eyes and nostrils and applies a filter to them in a second!
stations.hint: Type import cv2 and then in the next line print("OpenCV camera and face detection turned on!").
stations.challenge: Call the vision library import cv2 and print the statement OpenCV camera and face detection turned on!.
stations.starter_code: # Call the OpenCV library and run the camera:

pills.label: Turn on face detection
pills.code:
import cv2
print("OpenCV camera and face detection turned on!")

validation_rules.required_output_text: OpenCV camera and face detection turned on!

stations.title: Station 3: Huge Language Models (ChatGPT)
stations.desc: Discover how generative AI models (LLMs) work and how they understand and generate texts that mimic humans exactly.
stations.story: ChatGPT is not magic, but rather a generative artificial intelligence model trained on billions of texts and books to understand the context of speech and generate smart, coherent answers!
stations.simple: The genius robot writer costume! He read all the books in the world, and when you ask him a question, he thinks of the most appropriate words and puts them together in a beautiful and convincing way!
stations.challenge: Create a variable ai_reply="Hello, AI Hero" and print it to the screen.

stations.title: Station 4: Building the interactive chatbot
stations.desc: Learn the logic of building an interactive chatbot that asks the user his name and suggests learning paths.
stations.story: The smart chatbot saves time and serves thousands of visitors at the same moment! The bot asks questions, stores answers, and guides the user based on their choices.
stations.simple: Robot customer service employee uniform! He asks you (Welcome, what would you like to buy?) and when you choose, he takes you to the appropriate section immediately without waiting!
stations.hint: Type print("Welcome to Megaminds, what's your favorite track?").
stations.challenge: Print the bot's welcome message: Welcome to Megaminds, what's your favorite track?.

pills.label: Bot welcome message
pills.code: print("Welcome to Megaminds, what is your favorite track?")

validation_rules.required_output_text: Welcome to Megaminds, what is your favorite track?

stations.title: Station 5: Image Neural Networks (CNN)
stations.desc: Learn about CNNs that mimic human brain cells and use filtering layers to extract image features.
stations.story: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are the secret behind computer recognition of images of cats, dogs, and cars! The network scans the image with small layers of filters to extract lines, colors, and features.
stations.simple: Like Detective Conan when he looks with a magnifying glass! He scans the picture one by one and looks for fingerprints and fine features to find out who owns the picture!
stations.hint: Type print("Image scanned and features successfully extracted by CNN").
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase The image has been scanned and features successfully extracted by CNN to simulate a neural network.

pills.label: Run CNN scan
pills.code: print("The image was successfully scanned and features extracted by CNN")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The image was scanned and features were successfully extracted by CNN

stations.title: Station 6: Programmer of the rock-paper-scissors game
stations.desc: The grand final stop! Programming the logic of an interactive game (rock, paper, scissors) against artificial intelligence and calculating the winner.
stations.story: The grand final stop in the Artificial Intelligence Lab! We will program the rules of the game (Rock, Paper, Scissors). We determine player choice and computer choice, and apply comparison rules to find out who wins!
stations.simple: Play the famous game with your friends! The paper covers the stone, the stone breaks the scissors, and the scissors cuts the paper! We program these rules so that the computer understands who won!
stations.hint: Type player = "paper", ai = "stone", then print("Player wins! Paper covers stone!").
stations.challenge: Initialize the variables and print the closing statement Player wins! The paper covers the stone!To celebrate the great victory!
